title: One tested input parser for the calculator template instead of a copy per venture
problem: 133 input-handling defects: blank fields silently replaced by the example value, '1,200' split on the comma, quoted CSV ignored, month-first dates assumed. The same bug recurs across calculators, a sign of copied template code.
change: A platform module (thousands separators, blanks as errors not defaults, quoted CSV, explicit date order) with tests, used by the venture template and adopted by existing calculators when touched.
